description: Authorized public data snapshots for the ResiliNet offline real demo. Copied into the repo through Kiro. Small (~1 MB total); allowlisted in .gitignore so a fresh checkout reproduces the offline real demo.

sources.role: hospital locations + licensed bed breakdown (ICU/MED_SURG/etc.) + DPH_FACILITY_ID
sources.license: Public Commonwealth of Massachusetts open data
sources.caveat: TOTAL_BEDS are LICENSED beds, NOT staffed beds -> used as a capacity PROXY (mixed_assumptions). 9 general acute adult hospitals included; pediatric/specialty/non-acute/closed excluded with documented reasons (see pipeline/data_real.py).

sources.coverage: Suffolk County, MA; 234 tracts; total POP20 = 797,936
sources.license: Public Commonwealth of Massachusetts open data
sources.caveat: POP20 is 2020 DECENNIAL population (NOT ACS). 4 zero-population tracts are excluded from disease modeling (geometry preserved separately).

sources.role: historical facility COVID occupied beds (weekly means) for backtest
sources.url: https://healthdata.gov/resource/anag-cw7u.json?$where=state='MA' AND fips_code='25025' AND collection_week between '2020-10-04T00:00:00' and '2021-05-30T00:00:00'
sources.coverage: Suffolk County facilities; 16 facilities x 35 weeks = 560 records; 2020-10-04 .. 2021-05-30
sources.license: U.S. public domain (HHS open data). Reporting stream ended ~May 2024; HISTORICAL only, not live.
sources.caveat: 85 suppressed/missing/negative COVID means; coverage field used to require full 7-day support. Weekly MEAN target compared via a declared weekly-batch observation operator.

not_shipped.reason: 244KB kit; optional reference; not required for the offline real demo. Available from https://hackachusetts2026.vercel.app/kits/tracks/healthcare.zip
